cardOverview.overviewText: The ICICI Purchase Card is a corporate charge card designed to streamline vendor and procurement payments with detailed spend tracking and ERP integration. It offers up to 45 days interest-free credit and comes with zero joining or annual fees. Ideal for businesses managing recurring expenses, but not meant for consumer rewards or travel benefits.
